title: API Key Management System

input.rawIdea: API key management. Create keys, show the secret once, then only a hash. Support expiration, revocation, and rotation. Scopes are read, write, and admin, each with an explicit allow-list of operations. Separate rate limits from daily quotas. Record usage and optional IP restrictions. Audit logs are authorized and retained for a stated period. Reject expired and revoked keys on the server. Never log secrets and never return a stored secret. Hash secrets for verification. Encrypt only if the original must be recovered, which it must not. Advanced analytics and generated documentation are out of the first release.

securityCases: Expired and revoked keys are rejected on the server, not only hidden in the UI.
negativeCases: A later GET returns the original secret.

mustNotAssume: the raw secret must be recoverable
